newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London firm after HSBC rises.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London firm after HSBC rises.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London firmed on Thursday boosted by a powerful performance from heavyweight banking group HSBC Holdings, dealers said.
HSBC shares climbed HK$3.15 to close at HK$241.15, lifted by a buying spree of UK bank stocks in London.

In its first session with the former British colony under Chinese rule, the Hong Kong London Reference index gained 85.83 points to close at 15,141.57. Earlier, the Hang Seng index fell 141.05 points to 15,055.74 after a see-saw day's trading.
Dealers said trade was quiet with the earlier decline in property shares in Hong Kong having failed to spill over into London.
